dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Philadelphia Eagles Snap Seven-Game Losing Streak With 19-16 Win Over Steelers
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Head coach Nick Sirianni's Philadelphia Eagles improved to 3-7 after edging Pittsburgh 19-16 in Week 11 to break a seven-game slide. Despite the victory, Philadelphia faces a quick turnaround visit to the 5-6 Dallas Cowboys on Thanksgiving while evaluating running back Saquon Barkley's arm injury.
bullets: Quarterback Joe Milton directed the offense alongside wide receivers DeVonta Smith and Darius Cooper, highlighted by a third-down 14-yard completion to Cooper, as detailed by [philadelphiaeagles.com Video](https://www.philadelphiaeagles.com/video/highlight-joe-milton-zips-a-14-yard-pass-to-darius-cooper-on-third-and-10).

Kicker Jake Elliott supplied critical points by converting four field goals, including a 55-yard strike, per [philadelphiaeagles.com Video](https://www.philadelphiaeagles.com/video/highlight-jake-elliott-s-fourth-fg-is-true-from-55-yards).

The victory ended a seven-game losing streak for head coach Nick Sirianni and defensive coordinator Vic Fangio, noted by [ESPN NFL Nation](https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50569074/eagles-snap-7-game-slide-win-steelers).

Running back Saquon Barkley sustained a left arm injury during the game and remains questionable ahead of Week 12, according to [Jimmy Kempski](https://bsky.app/profile/jimmykempski.bsky.social/post/3n2whzz7nzk2d).
